page: Microsoft Azure F32-8amds_v7 is a constrained-core virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor on the x86_64 architecture. Managed by Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance exposes 8 dedicated physical cores (8 vCPUs) at clock speeds reaching 4.5 GHz with a 1:1 thread-to-core mapping. It features 48 KB L1d, 1 MB L2, and 32 MB L3 cache, backed by vector extensions including AVX-512 (foundation, VNNI, and BF16) and cryptographic hardware instructions. Memory is provisioned at 256.0 GB, delivering an unusually high ratio of 32.0 GB per vCPU. The server bundles a high-capacity 3780 GB local NVMe SSD without discrete GPU accelerators.

Benchmark evaluations reveal top-tier single-threaded compute performance, placing in the top 10% for single-core stress-ng (3611.49), single-threaded gzip compression (41.08 GB/sec), and bzip3 decompression (18.14 GB/sec). Multi-core performance aligns with the median 50% due to the 8-core constraint, achieving 28792.13 in multi-core stress-ng and 24745.28 on PassMark CPU tests. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 51.88 GB/sec and write bandwidth achieves 33.99 GB/sec. For lightweight language model inference, it generates 388.4 tokens per second on 135M models, though performance drops to 5.05 tokens per second during prompt processing on 70B parameter models.

By coupling 8 high-frequency dedicated cores with 256 GB of memory and 3.78 TB of NVMe storage, the configuration maximizes cost efficiency for software licensed on a per-core basis. The primary tradeoff is the strict 8-core parallel processing ceiling. Microsoft Azure F32-8amds_v7 is effective for memory-intensive relational databases, in-memory key-value caches like Redis, large-footprint ETL transformations, and single-threaded batch analytics.
description: Microsoft Azure F32-8amds_v7 is a constrained-core virtual machine designed for memory-intensive workloads that require moderate core counts. Powered by an 8-core AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked at up to 4.5 GHz on Microsoft Hyper-V, the system provides 8 dedicated vCPUs with single threading per core, 256.0 GB of system memory (32.0 GB per core), and a bundled 3780 GB local NVMe SSD. It features AVX-512 vector acceleration and demonstrates top-tier single-core compute performance alongside average multi-core throughput. Uncached memory read bandwidth measures 51.88 GB/sec. By offering an expansive 256 GB memory footprint alongside significant local NVMe storage on only 8 cores, this instance optimizes per-core software licensing costs. It is well matched for per-core licensed relational databases, high-capacity Redis caches, memory-heavy data pipelines, and analytical batch processing.
